rows: Candidates must have passed 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics as compulsory subjects from a recognized board. A minimum aggregate score as prescribed by MHT CET guidelines is required.
Selection is through MHT CET 2025 followed by centralized counselling conducted by CET Cell Maharashtra.

admission.heading: B.Sc Admission 2025
rows: Candidates must have completed 10+2 in any stream (Science, Commerce, or Arts) from a recognized board. Students with a background in computer applications or mathematics will be preferred for Data Science specialization.
Merit-based selection based on the aggregate percentage in 10+2.

admission.heading: M.Tech Admission 2025
rows: Applicants must have completed BE/B.Tech/MCA/M.Sc in relevant disciplines like Computer Science, IT, Electronics, or Mathematics. For lateral entry, a PG Diploma or Advanced Certificate in AI/Data Science is mandatory.
Based on academic merit in the qualifying degree. Lateral entry students are considered for direct second-year admission.

admission.heading: M.Tech + PhD Admission 2025
rows: Candidates must possess a BE or B.Tech in the relevant stream from a recognized university. Strong academic background in core technical subjects is expected.
Selection based on merit and/or personal interview as per university norms.

admission.heading: PG Diploma Admission 2025
rows: A graduate or postgraduate degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Statistics, or Engineering is required from a recognized university.
Selection is based on academic merit in the qualifying examination. Some courses may require an interview.

admission.heading: Advanced Diploma Admission 2025
rows: Candidates should have completed graduation in a relevant stream such as Engineering, Computer Applications, or Science. Basic programming or analytical background is preferred.
Merit-based selection depending on the academic background and subject relevance.

admission.heading: Certification Courses Admission 2025
rows: Students must have passed Class 10 or 12 from a recognized board and should possess basic computer skills. Some technical programs may require prior exposure to design software.
Selection is on a merit basis, subject to availability of seats and relevance of academic background.

fees.heading: Faculty of Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandry, Ranchi, Jharkhand is one of the very reputed colleges. The college expanded and prospered under the guidance and leadership of (Late) Col. Dr. S. M. Ishaque, G.B.V.C., P.G (Germany), F.R.V.C.S (Sweden) who joined as the first principal. He made sure that the infrastructure of the college met the objectives of the students and hence, played an important role in establishing hostels, residential units and even the main building. The college was earlier a constituent college of the Ranchi University. It functioned under the department of state animal husbandry till the year 1970. However, the college later became an essential constituent of Rajendra Agricultural University (RAU) with its establishment in the year 1971 at Pusa, Samastipur. The college earlier offered only undergraduate courses and programs. However, from the year 1972, the college started offering post graduate courses in as many as six disciplines. It really helped the students. fees.heading: Adikavi Nannaya University FAQs Ques. Which companies visit Adikavi Nannaya University for placements? Ans. In 2019-2020, AKNU was visited by companies like TCS, Wipro, Infosys, BYJU, Mindtree and HAYGOT. The highest salary package was 10LPA which was offered by BYJU. Ques. What is the format for NANNAYACET conducted by AKNU? Ans. The candidate has to answer 100 multiple choice questions in 90 minutes. Each question contains four alternative answers. Ques. Are any scholarships available at Adikavi Nannaya University? Ans. Residential Scholarships are available for Students across all reserved categories. It can be availed if the student satisfies the condition of minimum 75% attendance in College in each quarter. If the candidate puts in less than 75% of attendance for valid reasons, he/she shall be paid scholarship in proportion to the attendance. Those who are absent themselves without valid reasons will not be paid any scholarship. Ques. What is the hostel fee at Adikavi Nannaya University? Ans: The hostel fee is same for both girls’ and boys’. The fee is based on the time duration of the students' course. The bifurcated detail of hostel fee is given below: S.no. Fund/expenditure Amount (In Rs.) Duration 1. Refundable caution deposit 4000/- - 2. Hostel development fund 2000/- 2 Years Course ( non refundable non transferable) 3. Hostel development fund 3000/- 3 Years Course( non refundable non transferable) 4. Hostel development fund 4000/- 4 Years Course( non refundable non transferable) 5. Mess expenditure per month Varies from 1900 to 2100+ maintenance charges - Ques. What is the intake for B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering at Adikavi Nannaya University? Ans. The intake for CSE is 60. Infact, the total number of seats available in all branches of B.Tech offered at Adikavi Nannaya University is 60 each. Ques. What is the application fee for the AKNU CET conducted by Adikavi Nannaya University? Ans. The application fee for Adikavi Nannaya University Common Entrance Test is INR 500 for general or OBC and INR 300 for SC/ST/PH. Ques. What courses are offered by Adikavi Nannaya University? Ans. Adikavi Nannaya University offers B.Tech and B.Ed at the UG level and at the PG level it offers courses such as M.Tech, MBA, MSc, M.P.Ed., and MA. Ques. Does AKNU accept national or state level entrance exam scores for the admission process? Ans. Yes, ANU accepts AP-EdCET, AP-EAMCET, NANNAYACET, CAT, MAT, XAT and APICET exam scores for the admission process. Ques. Does AKNU offer hostel facilities to its students? Ans. Yes, AKNU provides hostel facilities to the students studying at the institute. There are 2 separate hostels available for male and female students which also offer mess facilities. Ques. Does AKNU train its students for placement and internships? Ans. Yes, AKNU has an active and dedicated placement cell which regularly arranges workshops, guest lectures and training programs to enhance the skills of the students. The University also gives students ample opportunities to participate in campus recruitment drives attended by renowned companies. Ques. Does AKNU offer scholarships to its students? Ans. Yes, AKNU offers Jagananna Vidya Deevena (RTF), Jagananna Vasathi Devena (MTF) scholarship schemes to the research scholars. And Janmabhoomi yojana scholarship scheme for the reservation category candidates. Ques. What is the cutoff score for the B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering program at AKNU? Ans. AKNU accepts 11046 AP-EAMCET score for female candidates and 35189 AP-EAMCET score for male candidates for the B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering program from general category.

What is the format for NANNAYACET conducted by AKNU? Ans. The candidate has to answer 100 multiple choice questions in 90 minutes. Each question contains four alternative answers. Ques. Are any scholarships available at Adikavi Nannaya University? Ans. Residential Scholarships are available for Students across all reserved categories. It can be availed if the student satisfies the condition of minimum 75% attendance in College in each quarter. If the candidate puts in less than 75% of attendance for valid reasons, he/she shall be paid scholarship in proportion to the attendance. Those who are absent themselves without valid reasons will not be paid any scholarship. Ques. What is the hostel fee at Adikavi Nannaya University? Ans: The hostel fee is same for both girls’ and boys’. The fee is based on the time duration of the students' course. The bifurcated detail of hostel fee is given below: S.no. Fund/expenditure Amount (In Rs.) Duration 1. Refundable caution deposit 4000/- - 2. Hostel development fund 2000/- 2 Years Course ( non refundable non transferable) 3. Hostel development fund 3000/- 3 Years Course( non refundable non transferable) 4. Hostel development fund 4000/- 4 Years Course( non refundable non transferable) 5. Mess expenditure per month Varies from 1900 to 2100+ maintenance charges - Ques. What is the intake for B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering at Adikavi Nannaya University? Ans. The intake for CSE is 60. Infact, the total number of seats available in all branches of B.Tech offered at Adikavi Nannaya University is 60 each. Ques. What is the application fee for the AKNU CET conducted by Adikavi Nannaya University? Ans. The application fee for Adikavi Nannaya University Common Entrance Test is INR 500 for general or OBC and INR 300 for SC/ST/PH. Ques. What courses are offered by Adikavi Nannaya University? Ans. Adikavi Nannaya University offers B.Tech and B.Ed at the UG level and at the PG level it offers courses such as M.Tech, MBA, MSc, M.P.Ed., and MA. Ques. Does AKNU accept national or state level entrance exam scores for the admission process? Ans. Yes, ANU accepts AP-EdCET, AP-EAMCET, NANNAYACET, CAT, MAT, XAT and APICET exam scores for the admission process. Ques. Does AKNU offer hostel facilities to its students? Ans. Yes, AKNU provides hostel facilities to the students studying at the institute. There are 2 separate hostels available for male and female students which also offer mess facilities. Ques. Does AKNU train its students for placement and internships? Ans. Yes, AKNU has an active and dedicated placement cell which regularly arranges workshops, guest lectures and training programs to enhance the skills of the students. The University also gives students ample opportunities to participate in campus recruitment drives attended by renowned companies. Ques. Does AKNU offer scholarships to its students? Ans. Yes, AKNU offers Jagananna Vidya Deevena (RTF), Jagananna Vasathi Devena (MTF) scholarship schemes to the research scholars. And Janmabhoomi yojana scholarship scheme for the reservation category candidates. Ques. What is the cutoff score for the B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering program at AKNU? Ans. AKNU accepts 11046 AP-EAMCET score for female candidates and 35189 AP-EAMCET score for male candidates for the B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering program from general category.

rows: Candidates must register for the relevant entrance examination. UG applicants must apply for CUET UG, PG applicants must apply for CUET PG, while PhD candidates must apply for RGUPET through the university website.

CUET UG: INR 1000 (General) and CUET PG: INR 1200 (General)

The university prepares a course-wise merit list based on CUET scores (UG/PG), candidate category, and seat availability. For PhD programs, shortlisting is based on RGUPET scores.

Faculty Candidates with M.Sc. Degree in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, and such other allied subjects shall also be eligible for registration, provided their degrees are from recognized Universities and they are either working in Colleges affiliated to SSU or they are desirous of working under the guidance of recognized faculty of colleges affiliated to SSU.

a) Candidates with MD/MS, MRCP/FRCS (granted in UK on or before 11.11.1975 as per MCI Act 1956, second schedule) or equivalent Master’s degree awarded by a College/University recognized by MCI are eligible to register for Ph.D course in their subject of specialization. b) In case of clinical subjects only candidates possessing M.D., M.S., D.M., M.Ch or any equivalent P.G. degree after M.B.B.S. recognized by SSAHE are eligible. c) In case of Pre-Clinical and Para-Clinical subjects, in addition to candidates who have done M.D. or M.S. after MBBS degree, non-medical candidates with M.Sc., in Anatomy / Physiology / Biochemistry/ microbiology/ Pharmacology under Medical faculty as recognized by MCI are also eligible.

Candidates with MDS degree awarded by this Academy or by a recognized College/University recognized by DCI or a PG Dental degree considered as equivalent by SSAHE are eligible for enrollment for Ph.D course in Dentistry of this Academy.

Or The pre-professional/pre-medical examination with Physics, Chemistry and Biology, after passing either the higher secondary school examination, or the pre-university or an equivalent examination. The pre-professional/pre-medical examination shall include a practical test in Physics, Chemistry and Biology and also English as a compulsory subject. Or The first year of three years degree course of a recognized university, with Physics, Chemistry and Biology including a practical test in three subjects provided the examination is a “University Examination” and candidate has passed 10+2 with English at a level not less than a core course. Or B.Sc. examination of an Indian University, provided that he/she has passed the B.Sc. examination with not less than two of the following subjects Physics, Chemistry, Biology (Botany, Zoology) and further that he/she has passed the earlier qualifying examination with the following subjects – Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English.
